recipe: npm run website:build; npx playwright test -c packages/website/playwright.config.js storage.spec.js --workers=3 --reporter=json > /tmp/storehosts-browser.json; node benchmark/store-hosts-browser.js /tmp/storehosts-browser.json
environment: Ubuntu 24.04 ubuntu-playwright container, run as user joham; ordinary and COOP/COEP Vite preview servers

rows.scenario: isolated hosting selects an observed durable rung and captures sessions
rows.durability: persistent (OPFS with SharedArrayBuffer and cross-origin isolation)

rows.scenario: ordinary hosting uses the observed header-free durable rung
rows.durability: persistent (OPFS access-handle pool, no special headers)
rows.fallback: JD2061 — opfs-sab: cross-origin isolation is unavailable. Selected opfs-sahpool (persistent).

rows.scenario: IndexedDB persists close/reopen and an interrupted replacement preserves the last snapshot
rows.durability: persistent (atomic IndexedDB snapshots; writes await storage)
rows.fallback: JD2061 — opfs-sab: cross-origin isolation is unavailable; opfs-sahpool: storage denied by host fixture. Selected indexeddb-snapshot (persistent).

rows.scenario: memory is visibly non-durable when persistent storage is denied
rows.durability: in-memory (non-durable — persistent storage is unavailable; data lives until reload)
rows.fallback: JD2061 — opfs-sab: cross-origin isolation is unavailable; opfs-sahpool: storage denied by host fixture; indexeddb-snapshot: IndexedDB is unavailable. Selected memory (non-durable; data lasts until reload).
